fb_text:
"My guys won't use another app."

Neither would mine. So I didn't build one.

FieldNotes is a text thread. Your crew texts it between stops — voice note or typed, whatever they'd already send you.

"Riverside office — swapped the lobby ficus. Irrigation line on two is dripping. Need a valve Thursday."

That one text becomes the service log, the issue flag, and the follow-up reminder. Timestamped. Searchable. No download, no login, no training session.

I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. My new guy never calls me anymore. He texts FieldNotes. And when I need the gate code, I ask it instead of calling him.

The tool your crew will actually use is the one that doesn't feel like a tool.

Ask it the gate code yourself — 60-second demo, no install:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
